lighting_isotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient peak divided by uniform-bin mean
lighting_isotropy.visual_check: Neutral form shading and ambient occlusion only; no directional key or cast shadows observed.

median_conifer_crown_final_scale.measurement: Median visual crown-width sample, converted by 2560/1254 to final canvas scale.

buildable_vs_steep_fraction.basis: estimated fraction of non-water land area
buildable_vs_steep_fraction.method: Authoring-zone estimate from coherent level bench surfaces versus exposed cliff and cut faces.

water_mask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels
